allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Globe Textiles (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on February 13, 2025 for Allotment of Shares.

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Globe Textiles (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated February 10, 2025, titled "Press Release regarding oversubscription of our recent Rights Issue".

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Globe Textiles (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation on closure of the Issue Period of the Rights Issue of Globe Textiles (India) Limited

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Globe Textiles (India) Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on January 10, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 150139596 : 300279192, i.e 150139596 Equity Shares for every 300279192 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 3 per share.
